title: Free-text answers resolve exactly one question, or refuse
description:
A CORRECTNESS tick, not a UX one, and the operator wrote the rules — implement them fail-closed, do not redesign them:

- A Telegram reply-to a specific question message resolves THAT question. Deterministic; prefer it, and with privacy mode on it is the common path anyway.
- Bare text with exactly ONE open question across all projects resolves it.
- Bare text with TWO OR MORE open questions must REFUSE and list the candidates.

Never guess. The reason is provenance: an approval carries human authority into the verdict guard, so a wrong guess attributes the operator's approval to another project's gate — it does not merely answer the wrong question, it forges consent. That is why this is P0 alongside the funnel and not a polish item.

The refusal must be useful: list the candidate questions with project + epic + tick and how to answer each unambiguously.
